what: What did each Lunenburg town employee earn in 1963?
why: `report-gross-wages` holds per-employee earnings from the 1995-2010 reports and FY2011-FY2025. The 1963 annual town report prints no wage list: the whole text (124 pages) was searched for gross wages, payroll, wages and salary and found only aggregates (the accountant's wage lines in the schedule, p28-39; elected officials' salaries in the voted budget, p64) and the School Department's teaching staff listing (p109-116, which names staff, education, degree and years of experience and prints no pay; the one `payroll` hit is p109) (sources/data/report-tables/1963/). — closes: the Town's calendar-1963 payroll register (W-2 totals by employee) from the Treasurer's office.

what: What were the town's non-union salary grades and step rates in 1963?
why: `salary-schedule` and `report-classification-plan` read Schedule A from the 2010 report and FY2011 onward. The 1963 report records that a Wage Classification and Compensation Plan was being drawn up (the Personnel Study Committee's report, p13, engaged a consultant in May 1963, whose study was `essentially complete` in December 1963; Articles 10 and 11 of March 2, 1963, p67; $1,865.00 spent, p26) and prints no schedule; searched classification, salary schedule and grade (sources/data/report-tables/1963/). — closes: the consultant's December 1963 report on the compensation and classification plan (Sumner D. Charm and Associates), or the Personnel Study Committee's file.

what: What did each special revenue fund take in, spend and carry forward in 1963, town-wide?
why: `special-revenue-funds` holds forward, receipts, disbursements and balance by fund from the 1995-2010 reports. The 1963 report prints the school lunch and athletic accounts inside the School Department's own reports (p120, p107) and their year-end unexpended balances as lines of the balance sheet (p18: School Lunch Program 1,304.61, School Athletic Program 1,845.71), and the Treasurer's receipts and payments for them (p23, p25); no town-wide receipts-and-disbursements schedule by fund. Searched revolving and special revenue: no hit (sources/data/report-tables/1963/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1963 special fund ledger.

what: What was appropriated, spent and carried forward on each capital project fund in 1963?
why: `report-capital-projects` holds a separate capital project fund schedule from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1963 report prints no such schedule: the accountant's schedule lists each special article with its balance (p28-39), the balance sheet carries the unexpended balances (p18) and `Loans Authorized and Unissued` $35,000 (p19), and no capital plan is printed. Searched capital project and capital improvement: no hit (sources/data/report-tables/1963/). — closes: the Town Accountant's calendar-1963 capital projects ledger.

what: How many weighing and measuring devices did the Sealer test in 1963, and what did sealing bring in by device type?
why: `report-weights-measures` holds the Sealer's device counts and `sealing-fee-schedule` the fee per device from the 2001-2010 reports. The 1963 report gives the year's totals in prose on p48 (160 devices inspected, 155 adjusted and sealed, 5 condemned) and the Treasurer's receipts one line, `Sealer's Fees` $92.10 (p22), and the Sealer's budget line (p24); no count or fee by device type. Searched weights (p5, p24, p31, p48, p65) (sources/data/report-tables/1963/). — closes: the Sealer of Weights and Measures' 1963 test and fee record.

what: How was the 1963 tax rate of $82.00 built up from the levy, overlay and estimated receipts (the Assessors' recapitulation)?
why: The recapitulation form is printed on p9 and explained on p8, but Textract returned every amount split into digit groups across cells, so no figure was landed (NEEDS.md item 1); `report-valuation` holds the equivalent from the 1987-2010 reports. The prose gives some of it: Item E gross amount to be raised $1,572,964.98, motor vehicle excise $142,661.61 of $459,887.39 estimated receipts, net to be raised $921,071.25 (p8). The overlay of $29,000.00 and the 1962 deficit are on p9 only. — closes: a re-read of the p9 form in digit-group-aware form (the page is in the archive); the filed Tax Recap sheet itself.
